# Fintech lenders

This page is finished. The credit team read it, argued about two lines of it,
and signed it off at the end of the second quarter.

## Firmographics

Online lenders of fifty to four hundred people, based in the United States and
Canada, that make small business loans of ten thousand to two hundred and fifty
thousand dollars.

## Felt needs

Their credit teams cannot clear applications as fast as their marketing brings
them in. The material calls this "the queue on Monday morning".

## Use cases

They read bank statements and tax returns into one view in minutes, and decide
on the easy half of applications the same day.

## Current solutions

Two underwriters per hundred applications, a shared spreadsheet, and a bank
statement reader bought three years ago that nobody trusts.
